# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a stout woman who waddles when she walks. She is frequently seen sitting at her kitchen window keeping an observant eye on the Avonlea road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an outspoken, highly capable woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. She is intensely inquisitive about her neighbors' business and manages both her own household and various community organizations with notable efficiency. Though sometimes sharp-tongued and pessimistic, she possesses a warm, kind heart and is always willing to help those in need.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived at Lynde's Hollow in Avonlea, keeping a watchful eye over the community and running local church societies. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decided to adopt an orphan boy, Mrs. Rachel expressed her strong disapproval. Upon discovering that Anne Shirley had arrived instead, Mrs. Rachel visited Green Gables and insulted Anne's appearance, provoking an outburst of temper from the girl. After Anne apologized, Mrs. Rachel readily forgave her and grew quite fond of her over time. When Thomas Lynde passed away after a long illness, Mrs. Rachel was left alone on their mortgaged farm. Marilla invited her to move into Green Gables to live together, an arrangement that allowed Anne to attend Redmond College while Mrs. Rachel helped Marilla manage the household and the Keith twins.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028)_

## Quotes

> Well, I hope it will turn out all right. Only don’t say I didn’t warn you if he burns Green Gables down or puts strychnine in the well...  <sub>[v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028)</sub>

> There, there, get up, child. Of course I forgive you. I guess I was a little too hard on you, anyway. But I’m such an outspoken person.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>
